metadata.title: Universal Wisdom: Ancient Teachings & Modern Standards
metadata.notes: Bridging ancient human wisdom with modern professional standards.

nodes.title: Google Project Management Certificate
nodes.description: Foundations of project management: initiating, planning, and executing projects. Agile, Waterfall, and Lean methodologies. Practical skills for guild leaders.

nodes.title: Stoic Logic & The Inner Citadel
nodes.description: Ancient techniques for emotional resilience and epistemic humility. Marcus Aurelius and Epictetus. Managing the 'internal substrate' during systemic crisis.

nodes.title: Yoga Sutras & Biological Homeostasis
nodes.description: Patanjali's logic of the mind-body substrate. The science of breath (Pranayama) as a thermodynamic regulator. Linked to the Bioregional Vitality track.

nodes.title: Indigenous Mnemonics & Songlines
nodes.description: Advanced oral knowledge systems. Using spatial narrative to store 16k-dimensional environmental data. The origin of the Mycelix semantic mesh.

nodes.title: Taoist Flow & Substrate Efficiency
nodes.description: Lao Tzu and the logic of 'Wei Wu Wei' (effortless action). The physics of flow states and their role in high-velocity cooperative networks.

nodes.title: The Universal Sage Capstone
nodes.description: Synthesize a modern technical challenge (e.g. Solar installation or Mesh security) with an ancient wisdom framework. Prove that the solution is both technically sound and morally aligned.

holonic_capstone.deliverable: A 'Wisdom Charter' for a local guild, verified by the Symthaea Auditor and a consensus of 3+ elders.

edges.rationale: Stoic resilience provides the emotional foundation required for high-stakes project leadership.
Ayurvedic homeostasis provides the systemic context for soil-to-body nutrition.
Songline mnemonics provide the prehistoric intuition for high-dimensional semantic mapping.
Taoist non-action is the philosophical counterpart to optimal win-win game theory.
